style.styleTitle: Scottish Everlastings Ltd Classic Christmas Wreath
style.toneOfVoice: Bring timeless festive charm into your home with this 60cm classic red & green Christmas wreath. Expertly crafted with lush green foliage and vibrant red accents, this artificial wreath captures the warmth and joy of traditional Christmas décor, creating a welcoming focal point for any space. Perfect for hanging on doors, walls, or using as a table centrepiece, its full, balanced design adds depth and visual interest while instantly brightening your home for the season. The rich green tones and festive red highlights give it a classic, cheerful appeal that complements both traditional and contemporary décor styles. Measuring 60cm in diameter, this Christmas wreath is maintenance-free, staying vibrant and beautiful year after year. Effortlessly add a touch of classic holiday spirit to your home with this festive decorative accent. Bring indoors during adverse weather conditions. Wreath Width: W60cm. Wipe clean with a soft cloth.
